title: Left Kan extensions along $u^{\mathrm{op}}$ exist
statement:
Every presheaf $F$ of abelian groups on $*_{\mathrm{proét}}$ has a left Kan
extension $\operatorname{Lan}_{u^{\mathrm{op}}}F$ along the opposite of the
functor $u$ of [def-sfb-profinite-to-proetale].

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take L = u.op, C = Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ, D = (specZ.{u}.ProEt)ᵒᵖ, H = AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}, and the given F. Its HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension hypothesis unfolds (same file, lines 46–52) to a family of HasColimit instances. Supply this family objectwise by AddCommGrpCat.hasColimit, Mathlib/Algebra/Category/Grp/Colimits.lean:283. Each CostructuredArrow L V has its object type in Type (u + 1), so the sole additional Small.{u + 1} hypothesis is the automatic small_self instance, Mathlib/Logic/Small/Defs.lean:77. No continuity, sheaf condition, finite-limit preservation or smaller-universe essential-smallness theorem is used.

split_report.summary: Identified the item as a specialization of Mathlib’s pointwise-to-global left Kan extension instance. Checked the pointwise existence hypothesis by AddCommGrpCat.hasColimit and small_self in the coefficient universe u + 1, matching the upstream master declaration. The named declaration is absent in slopmaster2 and sorried on master, so no project attachment is claimed. Preserved the statement, source, import flags and blueprint metadata, removed the unnecessary imported proof in favor of the Mathlib match, and introduced no nodes.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the whole assertion and the colimit argument of lem-sfb-point-lan-exists.proof.md, in part 3 (Inverse image from the point) of sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point. The comma category is (u.op ↓ V.op), whose objects are pairs (S, V → u(S)); the imported essential-smallness sentence is discharged directly by its object-universe bound and Mathlib colimit instances.
